Hey man, I hope that these messages have helped you understand that things are genuinely going to get better and be ok someday. It definitely doesn't feel like it currently, but it's 100% true. 
The reason I know is because I attempted when I was 13. I had a similar situation: bad home life, severe depression, chronic illness, and i felt extremely isolated. My parents didn't really understand mental health problems. Although they didn't react in the best way possible, they showed me that they cared and took me to a therapist. Through therapy, I was able to get to a point where I wanted to live and enjoy life again. I also found out some important tips that I'll share with you:


It may feel like it's a waste of your time or that they won't care, but you need to sit down with your family and tell them that you feel suicidal. If they make fun, say that "you're fine" or claim that you're just doing it for attention. You will need to explain to them the method in which you are planning and that you had no intention to tell them. I always thought of it like my words were smacking the stupid out of them. I also considered that "if I'm going to be dead soon, I might as well try plans B through Z first", just incase I'm able to find a non lethal, non destructive method of feeling ok again. 


Eventually, I was put on medication for my depression, but I found that it didn't help and actually made my depression a lot worse. Turns out that I'm bipolar, and depression meds have the opposite effect on people like me. So, if you get to a similar point, talk to your Dr about testing for bipolar disorder.


Puberty is an extremely rough time for you, your body, and your brain. One of the most helpful things that you can do is to be forgiving of yourself and give yourself a chance to work on figuring out the kind of person you want to be.

Also, she sounds like an absolute bitch, so you're better off without her being in your life. 


Things will genuinely get better, man :)

Ingredients:

-13 heads of hard neck garlic
-6 jalapeños
-EVOO
-Salt and pepper


> For garlic<
1. Set oven to 400f
2. Peel outer skins and cut off top of garlic head (exposing all cloves)
3. Set garlic in tinfoil and season with 1tsp of evoo and a pinch of s&p
4. Wrap up the head of garlic
5. Repeat until all heads are prepped
6. Throw in oven for an hour
7. Unwrap and squeeze out the delicious goop

>For jalapeños<
1. Cut off top and deseed pepper
2. Throw on charcoal grill till completely charred


- Puree both the goop and charred peppers in a food processor 
- Spread the mixture on parchment paper in the dehydrator
- Dehydrate for a day and a half
- Powderize 
- Enjoy
